purpose: Structured handoff to secretary; preparation only, not a deployment or production acceptance report.

scope.newApplication: ai-services/app=hermes-mcp; one Recreate Pod, MCP + official tunnel-client; no new Agent
scope.productionBaseline: Existing production is the earlier text/image sidecar. Full-file Companion + integrations/hermes_file_plugin is NOT deployed by this template.

format: base/*.yaml uses the JSON subset of YAML 1.2, accepted by Kustomize; the offline checker intentionally accepts only this local format and no overlays/remote resources.

bun.versionSource: nix develop --offline --no-update-lock-file --command bun --version; project flake.lock's development environment
bun.status: Bun registry digest deliberately unfilled, not guessed. Dockerfile has no default and validates tag+digest syntax and actual Bun version. Release evidence requires independent verification.

tunnel.independentMetadataCheck: Anonymous GHCR token + v2/openai/tunnel-client/manifests/v0.0.16 returned HTTP200 and Docker-Content-Digest equal to the pinned OCI index. Only index, amd64 manifest and config metadata fetched; no layers pulled or image executed.
tunnel.verifiedMetadata: Entrypoint [/usr/bin/tunnel-client, run]; OCI revision 5f99daabd4aa4a77049e6d81d54a0d8c18335397; OCI version v0.0.16. No probe executable assumed.

imagePins.mcp: UNBUILT / UNFILLED. SOURCE_REVISION must be the final integrated 40-hex source revision, not an invented revision or the unmodified baseline. Export that exact clean source, frozen bun.lock and deploy build helpers as the build context; the label alone does not prove provenance. Build bundles mcp/index.ts into /image-app, never copies existing dist. No package or flake modifications.

fillSteps: Work on a reviewed deployment copy. Set ConfigMap private-owner and the SINGLE tunnel-id key; owner is nonempty, trimmed, <=256 UTF8 bytes, no Cc/Cf; tunnel-id matches ^tunnel_[a-z0-9]{32}$. MCP, private initializer and client reference the same key.

Keep auth-mode=private-tunnel, MCP host=127.0.0.1/port=8790, HTTP downloads=0. No PUBLIC_ORIGIN/ISSUER/JWKS/SUBJECT required. Keep file-origins=[] until actual ChatGPT attachment origins are independently confirmed.

Select a NEW dedicated empty Filesystem storage class/PVC for state AND outputs. Do not adopt, clone, mount or repair the old Hermes profile/volume. Validate target storage permissions, backup/retention and restart behavior separately.

Verify the exact Bun tag+digest, then build from the final clean integrated source with required BUN_IMAGE and SOURCE_REVISION build args. Record provenance and the resulting MCP registry digest. Replace all THREE REPLACE_ME_MCP_IMAGE values (runtime and both initializers) with the SAME immutable image reference.

Have the authorized secret operator provision ai-services/hermes-mcp-bridge key token and ai-services/hermes-mcp-tunnel key api-key OUT OF BAND. The .example contains empty schema placeholders only, is NOT a deployable credential store and is excluded from base rendering. Never put real keys in command arguments, this repository, evidence JSON or reports.

Run python3 deploy/private-tunnel/check.py --base <reviewed-base-copy>; independently render with kustomize build <reviewed-base-copy>. The checker does not render/apply and cannot verify cluster state.

After separately authorized staging/acceptance, copy release-inputs.json.example to an operator-controlled NONSECRET evidence record. Fill scope=text-only or files, sourceRevision, bunImage, mcpImage and required external confirmation references. Run check.py --base <reviewed-base-copy> --release-inputs <nonsecret-evidence.json>. A PASS checks attestations, not their authenticity; nothing is auto-published.

storageSafety.rootStage: Only /work/data, /work/mcp-temp, /work/tunnel-temp. Root UID0 with CHOWN/FOWNER only, all other capabilities dropped. O_PATH + O_DIRECTORY + O_NOFOLLOW walk holds ancestor FDs. Fresh root: owner0/group0, mode0700/0755/0777, entirely empty; chmod0700/fchown10000:10000 on held FD only. Existing owner10000/group10000/mode0700: check only, no chown. No DAC_OVERRIDE, no recursion or deletion.
storageSafety.nonRootStage: UID/GID10000 creates state and outputs0700, binding marker0600 written last. Existing roots must contain exactly marker/state/outputs; wrong binding, owner, mode, missing directories or symlinks fail closed. Interrupted initialization requires offline investigation, not auto-repair. Application owns ledger validation and creates0600 files.
storageSafety.binding: Marker persists SHA256(JSON.stringify([owner,tunnelID])) and private-tunnel mode even before a ledger exists. Changing mode/owner/tunnel over this PVC is refused. Never point at a fresh empty state directory or replace the PVC to bypass a binding failure.
storageSafety.knownConstraints: lost+found or other preexisting contents are refused. No fsGroup/recursive ownership migration. Target storage must support the fixed-FD filesystem operations and chown semantics; root-squashed or incompatible CSI volumes require separate review, not broader init privileges.
storageSafety.fixtureScope: One unprivileged fixture uses the invoking UID/GID for private-state checks. Tests new state, repeat with existing ledger preserved, identity/mode/owner/symlink/partial/old-directory refusal. It does NOT validate real root-to10000 chown, root capabilities or a CSI/PV.

secretBoundary.mcp: Bridge bearer secretKeyRef only; no tunnel-key mount.
secretBoundary.tunnel: Read-only /run/secrets/tunnel_api_key only; no Bridge token, state PVC or profile. api-key=file: path argument only. The official entrypoint already includes run.
secretBoundary.keyPermissions: Projected Secret mode0444 (decimal292) deliberately permits nonroot reading without fsGroup or copying secrets in init. It is mounted ONLY into the client; not a claim of UID-level isolation inside that container. Persistent app files and marker remain0600.
secretBoundary.rotation: Client reads key file at startup; authorized rotation requires Pod restart, not assumed hot reload. Shared ConfigMap environment also requires restart. Identity changes require explicit migration policy, never fresh-state bypass.

networkAndHealth.listeners: MCP127.0.0.1:8790, tunnel health127.0.0.1:8080; no Service/Ingress/NodePort/hostPort/hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC. No MCP ports declared.
networkAndHealth.policies: New MCP Pod denies all ingress; egress only kube-system/k8s-app=kube-dns TCP+UDP53, same-namespace app=hermes-agent TCP8787, public IPv4 TCP443 excluding private/reserved CIDRs. Additive backend ingress only same-namespace app=hermes-mcp to app=hermes-agent8787. Existing LAN rules are NOT edited.
networkAndHealth.externalChecks: Verify CNI enforcement, additive-policy unions, existing backend ingress selection, actual DNS labels/NodeLocal DNS, service DNAT behavior and actual Pod/Service/LAN CIDRs. Public443 exclusions assume listed IPv4 ranges; add site-specific nonpublic ranges before release. IPv6 is not enabled here. No live cluster/CNI checks performed.
networkAndHealth.trust: Containers share one network namespace; loopback is NOT container-level authentication/isolation. Both containers can reach allowed Pod egress. Secret mount separation is not a per-container NetworkPolicy boundary.
networkAndHealth.probes: MCP Bun exec reads localhost8790/health and localhost8080/readyz for Pod readiness; liveness checks MCP only. Does not need shell/curl inside official client. PodReady does NOT prove account permission, ChatGPT connectivity, model or original-file capability.

fullFileReleaseHardGates: Separately authorized profile-safe backend Companion/hermes_file_plugin upgrade, preserving original identity and profile
GET /v1/capabilities explicitly reports assets=true (Bridge asset transport capability; does NOT prove that the Hermes plugin is enabled or that model invocation succeeds)
Actual ChatGPT attachment origins confirmed before allowlisting
Real ChatGPT original-file upload/download roundtrip acceptance
Text-only acceptance may be tracked separately; must never be described as files-ready
